adversarial_framing_finding: General/Macro Press sweep surfaced the renewed Houthi-Saudi war in Yemen. Checked multiple outlets' framing of the 28 Sep Saudi airstrikes on a market in Taiz: The Nation (Pakistan)/AFP wire and Al Jazeera frame Saudi Arabia as the aggressor (Houthi-sourced civilian-casualty claims); The National (UAE) counter-frames the Houthis as the aggressor. The adversarial-framing item is included in Negative Articles citing The Nation.
notes: Themed keyword and watchdog/NGO searches via WebSearch returned no NEW standalone in-window reputational items beyond the Yemen-war cluster; that cluster was surfaced via the outlets' own RSS feeds (NYT, Guardian) and direct outlet checks. WebSearch under-indexed the same-day (28-29 Sep) window this run; RSS feeds (rss_saudi_filter, gnews_culture_feed) and direct WebFetch were the reliable in-window discovery paths.
